# CANDIDATE: VIX_COMPRESSION_ORB_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Low VIX compresses volatility, leading to tight opening ranges; a breakout of such a range with expanding volume often initiates a sustained move. This edge exists because low volatility environments suppress intraday noise, making genuine breakouts more likely to trend when accompanied by volume expansion.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: If prior day's VIX close < 12 AND today's 15-minute opening range (ORB) width < 0.15% of SPY price, then enter long on break above ORB high with volume > 1.3× 20-bar average volume; enter short on break below ORB low with same volume condition. Exit: stop at opposite ORB edge, TP1 at 2× risk (entry to stop), runner using trailing stop at 10% below high-water mark for longs (or above low-water mark for shorts). Regime filter: only active first 90 minutes; skip when VIX > 20 or during scheduled news windows (FOMC, CPI, NFP).
